name: Cherry Studio
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: Cherry Studio’s updater reads its automatic-download preference and disables installation on quit. The original Windows code-signature configuration claim remains unresolved.
limitations: New default-branch snapshot rather than historical release re-verification; the full updater service/configuration and electron-builder generated artifacts were not sufficient here to establish the Windows signature setting or framework enforcement.

original_evidence.text: | Cherry Studio | CherryHQ/cherry-studio | Electron (`electron-updater`) | Y | Y — auto-checks 5s after startup then every ~4h (±15% jitter) when `app.dist.auto_update.enabled` is set; `autoDownload` follows that same preference; install itself requires explicit user click ("Install Now" — `autoInstallOnAppQuit=false`) | Y — downloaded installer is executed by `autoUpdater.quitAndInstall()` | HTTPS, generic electron-builder provider at `https://releases.cherry-ai.com`; release-history JSON fetch is separately size-capped (1MB) and timeout-capped (10s) | N — no separate signature over the `latest*.yml` manifest itself (electron-updater's manifest is unsigned JSON/YAML served over plain HTTPS) | hash-from-manifest (electron-updater compares downloaded file's `sha512` against the value inside the HTTPS-fetched, unsigned `latest*.yml`) **+ OS code-signing at install** (Windows Authenticode via custom `scripts/win-sign.js`; macOS notarization via `scripts/notarize.js`, gated on CI secrets) — **but the extra electron-updater cross-check that the update's Authenticode signer matches the currently-installed app is explicitly disabled** (`verifyUpdateCodeSignature: false`) | Windows Authenticode cert used by `scripts/win-sign.js` (custom signer, not inspected further here); Apple Developer ID via `@electron/notarize` using CI-injected `APPLE_*` secrets | `src/main/services/AppUpdaterService.ts:62-135` (4h scheduled auto-check, `autoDownload` from preference, `autoInstallOnAppQuit=false`); `src/main/services/AppUpdaterService.ts:379-382` (`quitAndInstall`); `electron-builder.yml:103-105` (`verifyUpdateCodeSignature: false`); `electron-builder.yml:119-121,159` (`notarize: false` + custom `afterSign: scripts/notarize.js`); `electron-builder.yml:152-154` (`publish: provider: generic, url: https://releases.cherry-ai.com`) |

fields.label: auto
fields.value: Y — auto-checks 5s after startup then every ~4h (±15% jitter) when `app.dist.auto_update.enabled` is set; `autoDownload` follows that same preference; install itself requires explicit user click ("Install Now" — `autoInstallOnAppQuit=false`)

fields.label: downloads_and_executes
fields.value: Y — downloaded installer is executed by `autoUpdater.quitAndInstall()`

fields.label: transport
fields.value: HTTPS, generic electron-builder provider at `https://releases.cherry-ai.com`; release-history JSON fetch is separately size-capped (1MB) and timeout-capped (10s)

fields.label: manifest_signed
fields.value: N — no separate signature over the `latest*.yml` manifest itself (electron-updater's manifest is unsigned JSON/YAML served over plain HTTPS)

fields.label: payload_verification
fields.value: hash-from-manifest (electron-updater compares downloaded file's `sha512` against the value inside the HTTPS-fetched, unsigned `latest*.yml`) **+ OS code-signing at install** (Windows Authenticode via custom `scripts/win-sign.js`; macOS notarization via `scripts/notarize.js`, gated on CI secrets) — **but the extra electron-updater cross-check that the update's Authenticode signer matches the currently-installed app is explicitly disabled** (`verifyUpdateCodeSignature: false`)

fields.label: verifying_key_source
fields.value: Windows Authenticode cert used by `scripts/win-sign.js` (custom signer, not inspected further here); Apple Developer ID via `@electron/notarize` using CI-injected `APPLE_*` secrets

fields.label: evidence
fields.value: `src/main/services/AppUpdaterService.ts:62-135` (4h scheduled auto-check, `autoDownload` from preference, `autoInstallOnAppQuit=false`); `src/main/services/AppUpdaterService.ts:379-382` (`quitAndInstall`); `electron-builder.yml:103-105` (`verifyUpdateCodeSignature: false`); `electron-builder.yml:119-121,159` (`notarize: false` + custom `afterSign: scripts/notarize.js`); `electron-builder.yml:152-154` (`publish: provider: generic, url: https://releases.cherry-ai.com`)
